title: EFE Hello-World runbook outcome (D40)
description: Sprint D40 — captured outcome of the Hello-World business workflow exercised by the quarterly DR drill. Validates that the restored cluster supports the full register-catalog → register-class → register-sentence → resolve-catalog → execute → assert-HMAC business path within the 60s SLO budget (D40-DR-2). The schema is versioned ; v1.0.0 is the GA baseline shipped with M7.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

tenant_id.description: Drill-only synthetic tenant identifier (default `drill-helloworld-tenant`). MUST NOT collide with any production tenant id.

catalog_name.description: Catalog name registered during step 1. Same lowercase regex enforced by efe.v1.catalog.RegisterCatalog.

final_version.description: Catalog version after step 3 (sentence registered). Expected to be 3 (v1=register, v2=class appended, v3=sentence anchors compiled).

sentence.description: Canonical sentence registered during step 3 (default `Hello, world!`).

anchors_compiled.description: Number of anchor vectors compiled by the embedder during step 3. Zero is allowed only when the fallback Mock embedder is enabled.

request_id.description: Server-assigned request id from efe.v1.SwarmService.Execute response.

verdict.description: Swarm verdict. Drill PASSES on CONVERGED or CONTINUE ; FAILS on DIVERGENCE or MODE_COLLAPSE (signals a backend regression post-restore).

confidence.description: Final confidence score in [0, 1]. Drill assertions require ≥ 0.5 by default.

total_ms.description: End-to-end Execute latency in milliseconds. Hard cap 60_000 ms ≡ 60 s SLO D40-DR-2.

rounds_executed.description: Number of fusion rounds executed by the swarm controller.

hmac_chain_post_execute_ok.description: True iff `efe-server admin verify-audit-chain --since=1m --full` returned a healthy chain after the Execute step. False = the restore broke the HMAC chain → critical regression.

all_steps_ok.description: True iff every Hello-World step (1–6) returned a successful exit code AND every assertion passed.

elapsed_secs.description: Wall-clock duration of the Hello-World workflow end-to-end in seconds. Hard cap 60 s ≡ SLO D40-DR-2.

fallback_mock_enabled.description: Optional diagnostic field. True iff EFE_HELLOWORLD_FALLBACK_MOCK was set ; the drill SHOULD refuse this in production runs (see B-2 directing principle).
